name: Cabin Announcements
description: Automatic cabin PA for every flight, in Greek and English. Plays the welcome, crew door commands, safety demonstration, seats for take-off, after take-off, the captain's cruise and descent announcements, landing preparation, welcome to destination and farewell — each triggered by the real flight phase, lights and altitude. Includes go-around and turbulence announcements and a soundboard to play any of them on demand.

availableSettings.name: Automatic announcements
availableSettings.description: Play announcements automatically during tracked flights. The soundboard still works when this is off.

availableSettings.name: Language
availableSettings.description: Crew commands (arm/disarm doors, seats for take-off/landing) are always in English, as on real Greek airlines.

availableSettings.name: Play PA chime
availableSettings.description: Ding-dong before passenger announcements and a single chime before crew commands.

availableSettings.name: Cabin crew announcements
availableSettings.description: Welcome, after take-off, prepare for landing, welcome to destination, farewell.

availableSettings.name: Captain announcements
availableSettings.description: Cruise welcome, top of descent, go-around.

availableSettings.name: Crew commands
availableSettings.description: Arm/disarm doors and cross-check, seats for take-off and landing.

availableSettings.name: Safety demonstration
availableSettings.description: Plays during taxi-out (about two minutes in both languages).
